payload.rationale: Arizona is playing at home and won their first game comfortably 26-14, whereas Seattle won a close, low-scoring game 13-10. Seattle's injury report lists QB Sam Darnold as OUT, which could be a significant disadvantage to their offense depending on his role. Arizona has several players listed as questionable but only one OUT. Given the home-field advantage and a stronger Week 1 showing, Arizona appears to be the favorite. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that Arizona's questionable list is extensive, potentially impacting their depth, and Week 1 results are a very small sample size. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is that Seattle's offense might struggle significantly without Darnold, giving Arizona a larger edge than expected.
limitations: Only one regular-season game has been played by these teams; records and scoring totals are a very small sample.
No opponent-adjusted strength model or final game-day inactive list is supplied. Injury designations can change before kickoff.
Uncertainty regarding Sam Darnold's exact role (starter vs. backup) for Seattle in 2026.
